performance.title: Performance
performance.intro: Make the console and your games run smoother. Everything can be undone.
performance.motion.reduceSub: Turns off animations and keeps the background still.
performance.motion.info: The console no longer follows the Windows animation setting. It only changes if you choose it here. The background moves slowly and stops only while you play.
performance.windows.intro: They apply right away and need no permission. Turn them off and Windows goes back to how it was.
performance.tweak.gameMode.sub: Windows puts the game in front of you first.
performance.tweak.recording.sub: Xbox Game Bar stops recording while you play. Fewer stutters.
performance.tweak.backgroundApps.sub: Store apps don't work when you're not using them.
performance.tweak.transparency.sub: Solid Windows windows. Saves a bit of graphics power.
performance.windows.undo: Put Windows back as it was
performance.windows.info: Windows animations are not touched: the console stays animated anyway.
performance.game.toggleSub: When a game opens, the PC uses all its power. When it closes, it goes back to normal.
performance.game.noPlanInfo: This PC has no high performance mode. You can create one in Windows Power Options.
performance.game.nowFast: A game is open now: the PC is at full power.
performance.game.battery: On battery it uses more power. It starts off if the PC isn't plugged in.
performance.updates.intro: Keep Windows from bothering you while you play. Updates are not removed: you just choose when.
performance.updates.pauseSub: Opens Windows Update. You can pause for up to 5 weeks.
performance.updates.hoursSub: During these hours Windows won't restart the PC.
performance.updates.advanced: In Deep optimization: active hours from 8:00 to 2:00, no restarts while you are signed in and, if you want, block them completely.
performance.updates.safe: If you don't block them, security updates keep coming. Your PC stays protected.
performance.advanced.intro: Windows becomes clean and fast, with barely a trace of Windows. Windows asks for permission before anything happens.
performance.advanced.step.telemetry: Windows stops sending usage data and showing ads and tips.
performance.advanced.step.clutter: No more Widgets, Copilot, Cortana or Bing in search.
performance.advanced.step.services: Turns off services the console doesn’t use (search, prefetch, printing).
performance.advanced.step.power: Maximum performance plan. The controller and graphics card never sleep.
performance.advanced.step.games: Games come first: higher priority and hardware GPU scheduling.
performance.advanced.step.visual: Windows effects set to minimum. CouchDesk stays animated.
performance.advanced.step.antivirus: The antivirus stays on. It just skips your games and emulators.
performance.advanced.questions: It will ask you two questions
performance.advanced.q.apps: Remove built-in apps you don’t use? (News, Clipchamp, Teams…). You can reinstall them from the Store.
performance.advanced.q.updates: Block Windows updates? Not recommended: the PC stops getting security patches.
performance.advanced.applied: Already applied on this PC. You can undo it any time.
performance.advanced.started: Windows is asking for permission. Accept and follow the steps in the window.
performance.advanced.undoStarted: Windows is asking for permission to undo it. Accept and follow the steps.
performance.advanced.info: Everything can be undone with the button above. Removed apps can be reinstalled from the Store.
